يشتملوا (form VIII)
# يَشْتَمِلُوا (yaštamilū) /jaʃ.ta.mi.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# يُشْتَمَلُوا (yuštamalū) /juʃ.ta.ma.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
